data.long_meaning: Paranjay is a Sanskrit name that means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. It is derived from the words 'para' meaning 'above' and 'nay' meaning 'new' or 'victory'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Krishna, who is often depicted as a victorious warrior and conqueror. The name Paranjay carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Paranjay usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
